# gpcn_resource_group (Resource)

Manages a resource group in GPCN. Resource groups bind related resources together as a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Creating GPCN Resource Groups

terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpcn = {
      source  = "Global-Private-Cloud-Network/gpcn"
      version = "~>1.0.2"
    }
  }
}

provider "gpcn" {
  host = "https://api.gpcn.com"
}

resource "gpcn_resource_group" "example" {
  name        = "terraform-demo-group-update"
  description = "Example resource group for a demo with terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the resource group. Must be 1-64 characters

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description for the resource group. Maximum 255 characters

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Timestamp when the resource group was created in ISO-8601 format
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource group in UUID format
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp when the resource group was last updated in ISO-8601 format

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gpcn_resource_group.example "3d7ff43c-163b-4374-92f5-f9c3bcc40132"
```
